source_title: How I Got My First Sale On Gumroad
snippet_primary: "No one is coming to save your product. Not even Gumroad… until you make your first $10. Gumroad won't promote your product through their Discover page until you earn your first $10. That means no free exposure from Gumroad unless you prove yourself first."
subject_exact: Gumroad Discover promotion gated on earning the first $10
local_qualifiers: That means no free exposure from Gumroad unless you prove yourself first (author's wording)
parser_notes: Platform-mechanics claim asserted by a seller in a first-sale account; threshold stated as $10 in this source.
